events.title: Microsoft Edge: Summarization, Translation, and Citation will soon be supported by Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in our menus
events.titleJa: Edge の選択テキスト向け Copilot 要約・翻訳・引用機能の提供を中止
events.titleEn: Microsoft Edge: Summarization, Translation, and Citation will soon be supported by Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in our menus
events.summary: Menus in Edge where the user has highlighted content in the browser will soon support a summarization, translation, and citation with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
events.summaryJa: ブラウザーで選択したコンテンツから開く Edge のメニューで、Microsoft Copilot と Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat による要約、翻訳、引用を利用できる予定でした。なお、この提供計画は中止されました。
events.summaryEn: Menus in Edge where the user has highlighted content in the browser will soon support a summarization, translation, and citation with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
events.titleJa: Word の Copilot Chat Agent mode で文書を作成・編集・改良
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
events.summary: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next...
events.summaryJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot ライセンスのないユーザーも利用できます。チャットの編集モードで自然言語を使い、新規・既存の Word 文書を作成、編集、改良できます。必要に応じて Copilot が確認質問を行い、編集後に実施内容と推奨する次の手順をまとめます。

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can edit your document by default in Word
events.titleJa: Copilot はデフォルトで Word でドキュメントを編集できます
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can edit your document by default in Word
events.summary: The default chat experience with Copilot in Word now allows Copilot to directly edit your document. All changes made by Copilot are fully reviewable and reversible, and users can turn this experience off if needed.
events.summaryJa: Word での Copilot とのデフォルトのチャット エクスペリエンスでは、Copilot がドキュメントを直接編集できるようになりました。 Copilot によって行われたすべての変更は完全にレビュー可能で元に戻すことができ、ユーザーは必要に応じてこのエクスペリエンスをオフにすることができます。
events.summaryEn: The default chat experience with Copilot in Word now allows Copilot to directly edit your document. All changes made by Copilot are fully reviewable and reversible, and users can turn this experience off if needed.

events.titleJa: Researcher の Copilot メモリ
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
events.summary: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics. Note: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.
